hydra-gloves-emerald.name: ★ Hydra Gloves | Emerald
hydra-gloves-emerald.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. It was crafted out of classic black supple leather with a varnished green emblem.

ak-47-nightwish.name: AK-47 | Nightwish
ak-47-nightwish.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a deer and dreamcatchers in neon colors and finished with a pearlescent effect.

I've been saving this for a special occasion... – Booth, Arms Dealer

ak-47-red-laminate.name: AK-47 | Red Laminate
ak-47-red-laminate.desc: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been given a laminate stock.

aug-plague.name: AUG | Plague
aug-plague.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted using dark fantasy and horror as inspiration.

"Like a moth to a flame"

aug-stymphalian.name: AUG | Stymphalian
aug-stymphalian.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted to depict stymphalian birds from Greek mythology.

Artemis sends her regards

awp-black-box.name: AWP | Black Box
awp-black-box.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using matte black paint and finished with an orange stripe.

"Nothing fancy, you hear me?"

awp-snake-camo.name: AWP | Snake Camo
awp-snake-camo.desc: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using a snakeskin stencil in patches that have been outlined freehand.

bayonet-boreal-forest.name: ★ Bayonet | Boreal Forest
bayonet-boreal-forest.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

pp-bizon-candy-apple.name: PP-Bizon | Candy Apple
pp-bizon-candy-apple.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a red and black color scheme.

Great on cars, better on weapons

cz75-auto-tigris.name: CZ75-Auto | Tigris
cz75-auto-tigris.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with high-gloss paint in a tiger stripe motif.

cz75-auto-distressed.name: CZ75-Auto | Distressed
cz75-auto-distressed.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. The copper colored ceramic finish is wearing away with use.

Better with age

desert-eagle-naga.name: Desert Eagle | Naga
desert-eagle-naga.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been engraved with a mythological motif.

A beast in Indian mythology as well as on the battlefield

desert-eagle-trigger-discipline.name: Desert Eagle | Trigger Discipline
desert-eagle-trigger-discipline.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A pink isometric pattern has been custom painted on the barrel. The hammer and front sight have been painted bright blue.

Patience is its own reward

desert-eagle-fennec-fox.name: Desert Eagle | Fennec Fox
desert-eagle-fennec-fox.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a fennec fox on the barrel. The grip features teal and orange designs.

All the better to hear you with

dual-berettas-dezastre.name: Dual Berettas | Dezastre
dual-berettas-dezastre.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted with a high tech black, white, and red design.

Always follow manufacturer guidelines for safe use

famas-decommissioned.name: FAMAS | Decommissioned
famas-decommissioned.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. This custom paint job is inspired by elements found on de_nuke from Counter-Strike 1.6.

If found please return to Cedar Creek Nuclear Power Plant

five-seven-fowl-play.name: Five-SeveN | Fowl Play
five-seven-fowl-play.desc: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted with a pattern of falling feathers.

galil-ar-firefight.name: Galil AR | Firefight
galil-ar-firefight.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been given crimson accents and a hand painted icon.

Booth had this weapon commissioned for Valeria in an attempt to smooth things over with the Phoenix

galil-ar-sage-spray.name: Galil AR | Sage Spray
galil-ar-sage-spray.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

glock-18-grinder.name: Glock-18 | Grinder
glock-18-grinder.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. The steel slide has been painted using a combination of stenciling and hand-painting using oil paints.

The only way to make diamonds is by applying pressure

p2000-silver.name: P2000 | Silver
p2000-silver.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent silver anodized effect paint.

There is beauty in simplicity - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

p2000-handgun.name: P2000 | Handgun
p2000-handgun.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with a hand making an aiming gesture.

No more fun and games

butterfly-knife-fade.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Fade
butterfly-knife-fade.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Gamma Doppler
butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

paracord-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

falchion-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-lore.name: ★ Flip Knife | Lore
flip-knife-lore.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

flip-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Flip Knife | Crimson Web
flip-knife-crimson-web.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

karambit-night.name: ★ Karambit | Night
karambit-night.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

m9-bayonet-rust-coat.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Rust Coat
m9-bayonet-rust-coat.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

shadow-daggers-boreal-forest.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Boreal Forest
shadow-daggers-boreal-forest.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

skeleton-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Rust Coat
skeleton-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

skeleton-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe
skeleton-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

stiletto-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m249-jungle-ddpat.name: M249 | Jungle DDPAT
m249-jungle-ddpat.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m249-jungle.name: M249 | Jungle
m249-jungle.desc: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a jungle color scheme.

m4a4-dragon-king.name: M4A4 | 龍王 (Dragon King)
m4a4-dragon-king.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with the image of a dragon in red and blue.

A weapon worthy of The Monkey King himself - Booth, Arms Dealer

m4a4-neo-noir.name: M4A4 | Neo-Noir
m4a4-neo-noir.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a stylized blue-magenta woman over a grayscale background.

"She grabbed what she could and disappeared into a decaying dystopia"

m4a1-s-basilisk.name: M4A1-S | Basilisk
m4a1-s-basilisk.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been etched with a basilisk.

It's rude to stare, but war isn't the time for pleasantries

m4a1-s-welcome-to-the-jungle.name: M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle
m4a1-s-welcome-to-the-jungle.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. This custom paint job features ancient iconography and a golden pit viper before a dusk-tinted jungle background.

Strike without warning

m4a1-s-varicamo.name: M4A1-S | VariCamo
m4a1-s-varicamo.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

mac-10-malachite.name: MAC-10 | Malachite
mac-10-malachite.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted using metallic effect paints and given a wavy pattern using a rubber comb tool.

Bright colors hide a gun with a dark purpose

mac-10-curse.name: MAC-10 | Curse
mac-10-curse.desc: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a graphic image of a mummy.

mag-7-swag-7.name: MAG-7 | SWAG-7
mag-7-swag-7.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been covered in monochromatic silver and black designs.

You either have it or you don't

mag-7-resupply.name: MAG-7 | Resupply
mag-7-resupply.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to resemble an ammunition box.

Keep the receipt

mp5-sd-liquidation.name: MP5-SD | Liquidation
mp5-sd-liquidation.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. Its dark base and carefully selected red and blue highlights make this custom painted MP5-SD appear as if it's glowing under ambient light.

Quiet reflection

mp5-sd-neon-squeezer.name: MP5-SD | Neon Squeezer
mp5-sd-neon-squeezer.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. Neon-colored paint pen graffiti doodles have been applied over a dark base.

"It's art, I shouldn’t have to explain it"

mp7-armor-core.name: MP7 | Armor Core
mp7-armor-core.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted with black oil-based paint and given brushed stainless steel parts and inlay.

Perfect for the Operator that values sophistication as well as firepower - Booth, Arms Dealer

p250-dark-filigree.name: P250 | Dark Filigree
p250-dark-filigree.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A deep red hydrographic pattern has been applied over a charcoal base.

Perhaps this is one piece of art better left in the past

r8-revolver-mauve-aside.name: R8 Revolver | Mauve Aside
r8-revolver-mauve-aside.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. The grip has been painted with a plum-colored acrylic pour pattern.

A gentle pour

scar-20-army-sheen.name: SCAR-20 | Army Sheen
scar-20-army-sheen.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

scar-20-brass.name: SCAR-20 | Brass
scar-20-brass.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. Parts of the weapon have been replaced with brass.

Fool's gold

scar-20-stone-mosaico.name: SCAR-20 | Stone Mosaico
scar-20-stone-mosaico.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted with a tan colored cracked tile hydrographic.

Watch your step

scar-20-torn.name: SCAR-20 | Torn
scar-20-torn.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been spray-painted with a randomized stripe pattern.

To shreds...

sg-553-desert-blossom.name: SG 553 | Desert Blossom
sg-553-desert-blossom.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted with vibrant flowers atop a dry, cracked base.

Nature always wins

ssg-08-hand-brake.name: SSG 08 | Hand Brake
ssg-08-hand-brake.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been hand painted with blue and white checkerboard patterns.

Meant for oversteer, not parking

ssg-08-sans-comic.name: SSG 08 | Sans Comic
ssg-08-sans-comic.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A grayscale pattern featuring high gloss silver paint has been applied.

"The red light means it's recording"

tec-9-titanium-bit.name: Tec-9 | Titanium Bit
tec-9-titanium-bit.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. Its barrel shroud has been anodized to a royal blue color and subtly fluted.

tec-9-bamboozle.name: Tec-9 | Bamboozle
tec-9-bamboozle.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A custom bamboo paint job has been applied.

Don't be deceived

tec-9-phoenix-chalk.name: Tec-9 | Phoenix Chalk
tec-9-phoenix-chalk.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A multicolored pattern of various Phoenix Connexion graffiti has been applied.

"You are stupid to think you will win!"

ump-45-gunsmoke.name: UMP-45 | Gunsmoke
ump-45-gunsmoke.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted using a hydrographic of a gel pen doodle.

usp-s-road-rash.name: USP-S | Road Rash
usp-s-road-rash.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with the image of a flying bullet, then weathered with sandpaper.
